status: Validated for the stated trial and static scope. One model-pair round ran on an earlier candidate; the final wording was changed after it and is not pair-reviewed.
request: An agent wrote a long `suggestion:` inline comment on another author's PR in a private repository, asking to call one more function on invite resend and retelling the whole causal chain. The change was not a defect of that PR: one of the user's PRs depends on the date it would update. The user rewrote it as one sentence: the ask plus that dependency. Goal: the minimal general change that keeps such requests to the ask and the dependent work.
diagnosis: The incident session loaded the installed comment-style, which links to a local main at a8e115b. Its references/review.md still said 'shorten the explanation, not its evidence' (hypothesis 1) and had no length budget for findings (hypothesis 2). Commit 6cad78e on origin/main already removed that sentence and added the 40-word budget.

On origin/main, Claude still framed the incident as a defect: 2 of 2 runs led with the backfill inconsistency and none named the dependent PR. The defect budget (what goes wrong, its trigger, the rule) was the only shape for a new comment, so a request born of the commenter's own dependency was written as a finding (hypothesis 3).

Hypothesis 4 (a final one-sentence check) was not adopted: SKILL.md already ends with a recipient read-through for every message, and an absolute sentence count would contradict the recorded decision to drop sentence ceilings.

changes.change: 'Word a new finding': a change your own work depends on starts with its point, like a defect or a genuine question, instead of `suggestion:`. 'Say enough to find the problem': when the PR works without a change your own work depends on, the comment is a request, not a finding, usually one sentence with the ask and the work that depends on it, such as a link to your PR, leaving out why that work needs it.
One added base deviation crediting the user's decision of 2026-10-22.

trials.final_summary: Every request case on both hosts starts with the ask and gives the dependent work as the reason without the investigation chain (9-28 words). Claude incident 3 of 3 pass, in a question plus a short reason. Both defect cases keep what goes wrong and its trigger on both hosts, and the optional suggestion keeps `suggestion:`. One run per host per case except Claude incident (3); small samples support only these cases.
